prompt: Describe your ideal Saturday in under 100 words. Every sentence must be independently American.
response: My ideal Saturday begins with black coffee and a towering stack of pancakes drenched in maple syrup. Baseball highlights blast from the television while I grill burgers in the backyard. Friends swing by for an epic tailgate with apple pie and ice-cold Budweiser. We cheer wildly as the Stars and Stripes wave proudly overhead. Later I hit the open road in my Ford pickup, chasing that endless American dream until the sun sets on another perfect day. God bless the USA.
